## Technical Blog & Writeups



- [Advanced Malware Evasion: Bypassing EDRs with Direct Syscalls, ETW Patching, and AMSI Bypass — The Complete Guide](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/posts/advanced-malware-evasion-bypassing-edrs-with-direct-syscalls-etw-patching-and-amsi-bypass-—-the-complete-guide/): Modern EDRs hook every API call you make and trace every system event. This deep dive teaches you how to go invisible: patching EtwEventWrite in memory to blind ETW, executing direct syscalls from raw assembly to bypass user-land hooks entirely, performing Process Hollowing and Thread Hijacking, and patching AMSI so your PowerShell payloads never get scanned.
